title: Create: Just for Fun
body:
# Create: Just for Fun

A casual Neoforge 1.21.1 modpile built around the Create ecosystem, designed for players who want a rich mechanical sandbox without the hassle of choosing dozens of mods themselves.

## What's Inside

This modpack centers on Create and expands it with a set of addons and complementary mods:

- Create - The core mechanical engineering mod: gears, conveyors, trains, and contraptions.
- Create: Aero - Take Create to the skies with airships and aerial contraptions.
- CC: Tweaked - Programmable computers and turtles, great for complex automation.
- Addons & extras - A collection of supporting mods that extend and enhance the above.

Everything (with small exceptions) is left at default configuration, following each mod creator's intended experience.

## Why This Modpack?

- Plug and play - A pre-assembled collection of compatible Create-family mods so you don't have to chase down versions and dependencies yourself.
- Focused on a single thing - Adds engineering challenge, without overhauling unrelated systems.
- Open development - Don't like something? Want a mod added? Suggest changes on the GitHub repo.

### Hardware Requirements

| Component        | Required                  | Recommended       |
| ---------------- | ------------------------- | ----------------- |
| CPU              | Coffee Lake Refresh/Zen 2 | Raptor Lake/Zen 4 |
| RAM/Allocated    | 16/8GB                    | 16/8GB            |
| Storage          | SATA SSD                  | NVMe SSD          |
| GPU              | Iris Xe/Vega 7            | ARC B570/RX 7600  |
| OS               | Linux                     | Linux             |

Performance issues on systems below the `Required` specification will be closed, unless the issue can also be replicated on supported hardware.

## Alternative method of installation

This modpack is developed using packwiz. This opens up a possiblity of using it instead of modrinth for installation. Why would you do that? It's a more native way and you will get (Automatic!) updates as soon as they're pushed.

1. Create minecraft instance with Neoforge 1.21.1
2.  Go to [this github page](https://github.com/packwiz/packwiz-installer-bootstrap) and download packwiz installer bootstrap from releases
3. Put the downloaded .jar file to your minecraft instance root
4. Add the following:`"$INST_JAVA" -jar packwiz-installer-bootstrap.jar https://first-non-interesting-username.github.io/create-just-for-fun/pack.toml` to your instance extra launch arguments
